verdict.rationale: An AI-training data opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS payments platform that processes user and seller data, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers AI training on customer data, opt-out controls, or data-usage policy. The MCP server and llms.txt items concern developer tooling, not training-data privacy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
